name: 109 會考模擬二模（康軒 1～3 冊）英語閱讀
source: 康軒 109 學年國中教育會考模擬測驗（第二回・九年級 1～3 冊），答案與解析取自官方詳解
passages:
Ariel: Peter and I are going to watch The Quiet Night at 10:30 p.m. Would you like to join us?
Danny: Thank you for inviting me, but I have an English class at 11.
Ariel: Are you kidding me? An English class at 11?
Danny: It’s an online (線上的) class, and I will take it at home.
Ariel: But why is it at 11? It’s pretty late at night.
Danny: Because the teacher, Mr. Miller, will be teaching us in the USA. It’ll be 9 in the morning there. And my classmates are from around the world. We are in different time zones.
Ariel: It sounds interesting! Can you see each other’s faces?
Danny: Of course. Let me show you our classroom. Look, I can see my classmates’ faces on the right-hand side.
Ariel: Will the teacher’s face be in the middle?
Danny: No, Mr. Miller’s face will be on the top right corner, and the main (主要的) area (區域) is his computer screen. It’s like the blackboard in a school classroom.
Ariel: And what is the bottom part for?
Danny: It’s for typing, but we only type when others can’t hear us.
Ariel: I see. It’s so cool!

We’re still waiting,
Waiting for the gifts from above.
We wait and wait,
But nothing comes.
Grass and flowers are so down;
They can no longer hold their heads up high.
Trees have nothing to nourish (滋養) their green hair;
Their hair turned brown and fell to the ground.

We’re still waiting,
Waiting for the gifts from above.
We wait and wait,
But nothing comes.
Land and fields (田地) are so sad;
They aged so much, with lines all over their faces.
Lakes and ponds gave up the hope long ago;
They left for good and will come home no more.

We’re still waiting,
Waiting for the gifts from above.
We wait and wait,
But nothing comes.
Baby cattle (牛隻) are thirsty for milk,
But with no water or pastures (牧草地),
Mother cows give no milk.
Young children are crying for rice,
But with dry fields and with the ponds shy,
The farmers grow no rice.

We’re still waiting,
Waiting for the gifts from above.
We wait and wait,
But nothing comes.

【The Baseball Team of the Department of Math (The BOM)・Public Group・150 People】
Charles Lee　July 11 at 16:15
About the baseball game tomorrow, I have a few important things to say. Tomorrow we’ll be fighting against (對抗) the baseball team of the Department of History. However, the Department of History threw us a curveball there—they changed their starting pitcher (投手) from Xavier Lin to Wayne Hsu. Wayne Hsu is very good at curveballs. Some of you might not know his curveballs well. When he throws a curveball, the ball doesn’t fly straight from beginning to end. It moves down and flies close to the ground before it flies into the catcher’s glove.
To deal with this problem, I have to change the batting order tomorrow. The best hitter of our team, Ethan, will be the fourth hitter tomorrow, with Joshua right before him and Jamie batting right after him. The first hitter will be Hank, and the second will be Nelson. The sixth hitter will be Brad, and the hitters following Brad in order will be Steve, Ian, and me. I’m also changing our starting pitcher from Brad to Jamie, for Jamie is in a better state (狀態). Brad will be the catcher tomorrow. The rest of the players will be at the same fielding positions (守備位置) as I told you yesterday. I hope the new batting order will help us face their new starting pitcher and win the game.
The baseball game begins at nine o’clock tomorrow morning. Please get to the baseball field (球場) two hours before the game starts, and don’t forget to bring your own water.

Hi Sarah,
I’m writing to you because I need some help. As you know, Karen, Leo, and I decided to share an apartment last year, and all of us were excited about that. However, problems started to appear after we lived together for a month.
Please look at the floor plan of our apartment（見第 23 題附圖）. Because it seemed (似乎) a little strange for a girl and a boy to share a bathroom, Karen and I decided to share the one outside. So, Leo took the room with a bathroom, and he pays 500 NT dollars more than we do every month. Karen often cleans our bathroom. That is good, but the problem is—she doesn’t like anyone to use it right after she finishes cleaning. She wants to keep it clean too much, and sometimes that makes me feel stressed (有壓力的). Karen also cooks a lot. When she cooks, the smoke and smell get into my bedroom although my door is always closed. I’m thinking about changing bedrooms with Karen because hers is farther from the kitchen. Or, should I change with Leo so that I can have my own bathroom? I feel really “bothered,” but I don’t want to make them unhappy. Do you have any good ideas? Please let me know.

Many thanks,
Zoe

(PES TV is a television station in Utopia City. They’re talking about their current (目前的) TV programs in a meeting.)
Amy: I think we should keep airing (播出) Scary Dragons. It has been our best TV program for the last two months.
Ben: It does well only because it is summer vacation. The vacation is about to end, and kids are going back to school. I don’t think there’ll be anybody watching it at home in the morning then. It’s a program for kids after all. What do you say, Cate?
Cate: I think we can keep doing the program but change its time. What about moving it to 20:00-22:00? Kids can watch it after they finish their homework.
Ben: Not good. Now we have City Girls during those two hours, and it is our second-best program. Over five thousand people love to watch the show in the evening.
Cate: Why don’t we stop airing Mother-in-Law and let Scary Dragons take its place? Mother-in-Law is our worst program.
Amy: Mother-in-Law doesn’t have a large audience (觀眾), but I think it fails only because we put it in the wrong hours.
Cate: You’re right. It’s a program for housewives, but we air it between 16:00 and 18:00. Housewives need to cook dinner then and don’t have time for TV.
Ben: Housewives usually watch TV between 14:00 and 16:00. I think we can move Mother-in-Law to those two hours.
Amy: Does that mean we’ll move the program in those two hours, Strange Food, to 10:00-12:00?
Ben: Right. Strange Food isn’t very popular, and usually there are the fewest people watching TV in the morning.
Cate: All right. Our new schedule (時刻表) looks great!
（Program ①～④ 各年齡層收視人數長條圖見第 26 題附圖）

Sleeping sickness first appeared in Africa thousands of years ago. People with sleeping sickness have trouble sleeping at night, so they are tired all the time and always feel like dreaming during the day. When a case of sleeping sickness appears in one place, soon many other people living in the same place will get it, too. At first, people thought it had something to do with dark magic. Later, they found out sleeping sickness is caused by (因……而起) several kinds of insects and the parasites (寄生蟲) inside their bodies.
One common kind of these insects is the tsetse fly. Tsetse flies feed on the blood (血液) of people and animals like cows and horses. When “they” are biting people, the parasites get into people’s bodies. They would later get to other body parts with blood and give people a headache and a high fever. About a month later, the parasites would get to people’s brains (腦部). With these parasites attacking their brains, people aren’t able to tell days from nights or tell nights from days. The 24-hour sleep-wake cycle (週期) in their brains breaks down, so they can’t fall asleep (睡著的) at night and are too tired to go to work during the day. People might die in months if they don’t take medicine to get the parasites out of their bodies.
Some people in Africa use nets to catch tsetse flies, and some cover their bodies with clothes to avoid (避免) insect bites. However, there are still thousands of cases of sleeping sickness in Africa every year.

KNSH NEWS
by Leila Benson　Oct. 30, 2020
The most popular pizza restaurant in Utopia City, Pizztopia, always thinks hard about bringing people new pizza flavors (口味). They announced (宣布) an exciting piece of news today: Next year, people in Utopia City ＿35＿ able to enjoy the “Fried Noodle Pizza” in Pizztopia. Lots of people in the city are very excited about the news. They can’t wait to try the new flavor, and many of them are talking about booking a table in Pizztopia next year. “We’re still testing the new flavor because we hope to bring people the best pizza,” said a worker in Pizztopia, “We plan ＿36＿ with another popular restaurant in Utopia City, Noodopia, to make the new pizza taste great.”
Pizztopia is world-famous because of some of its strange pizza flavors. For example, in the year 2017, they surprised people in Utopia City by bringing them “Pork Rice Pizzas,” and in 2019, they sold over one hundred “Milk Tea Pizzas” a day. Their pizza flavors ＿37＿ really interesting, and people in Utopia City even have a group on Facebook to talk about their favorite pizza flavors.
＿38＿, it is not so exciting for Italians to put food like pork rice or noodles on pizzas. As people from the home of pizza, the Italians are not happy about the new flavors of Pizztopia. Many of them attack Pizztopia’s strange ideas of making pizzas on the Internet every day, and some even want to come to Utopia City to boo (向……喝倒采) the restaurant in person. Pizztopia is not afraid of the attacks, though. They want to keep bringing people funny and strange pizzas.

In June 2020, pictures like the one on the right（一隻受傷的母象，肚子裡有一隻小象）started to appear on the Internet. There is a sad story behind the picture.
People first noticed the mother elephant on the street. She got hurt and was running around then. When she finally stopped in a river, many people tried to save her. However, she didn’t want anyone to get close to her. In the end, without making any noises, ＿39＿. After she passed away, people found there was a little elephant in her body. That broke many people’s hearts.
Then how did the mother elephant get hurt? It was because she ate a pineapple (鳳梨). The pineapple was not a common one. Someone put firecrackers (爆竹) in it, but the poor mother elephant didn’t know that. ＿40＿, the firecrackers went off in her mouth. The fact burned many people up, and the police caught a suspect (嫌疑犯) quickly.
As the news spread (傳開) on the Internet, ＿41＿. They hope the pictures can make more people know about the story and help stop things like this from happening again.

questions.q: Look at the picture. What is the girl with short hair doing?
o: She is having lunch with the boy.
She is playing with water in the river.
She is shouting at her two friends.
questions.e: 由圖片可知短頭髮的女孩正在河裡玩水，故選(C)。

questions.q: Let Her Go is Dan’s ＿＿＿ song. He listens to it every night before he goes to bed.
questions.e: 由「每晚睡前都會聽」，可推知應是「最喜愛的」歌曲，故選(D)。

questions.q: The boys’ father ＿＿＿ at a car factory before, but he lost his job last month. Now, he is looking for a new job.
questions.e: 描述發生在過去的事實應用過去簡單式，故選(C)。

questions.q:
Terry: ＿＿＿ reading English comic books help you learn English?
Gale: Yes, I learn a lot from these comic books.
questions.e: 問句主詞為 reading English comic books 這一個動作，且後有動詞 help，因此須用第三人稱單數助動詞 does，故選(A)。

questions.q: These special trees grow ＿＿＿ in Japan. We can’t see them in other countries.
questions.e: 在別的國家都看不到這些特別的樹木，表示「只」生長在日本，故選(B)。

questions.q:
Rita: What is John doing in the ＿＿＿?
Alex: He is making an apple pie. He invited his friends to his house tonight.
questions.e: 由 Alex 回答 John 在做蘋果派，可推知他應該是在「廚房」裡，故選(C)。

questions.q: Listen, Harry. Someone ＿＿＿ outside. It might be Dora. I saw her having a big fight with her husband this morning.
questions.e: 由前句「Harry，你聽。」，可推知後句是描述現在有人「正在外面哭」，用現在進行式，故選(B)。

questions.q:
Jane: ＿＿＿ will the weather be like the day after tomorrow?
Gina: The weather report says there will be lots of rain. We’d better bring umbrellas with us on our trip.
questions.e: 詢問天氣句型為 What + be 動詞 + the weather + like? 或 How + be 動詞 + the weather?，故選(B)。

questions.q: My grandpa seldom takes ＿＿＿ when he is sick. He usually stays home and gets more rest.
questions.e: 後句提到「通常待在家多休息」，可推知爺爺生病時很少吃「藥」，故選(B)。

questions.q: Anna did not want to miss the interesting live show, ＿＿＿ she got home early and turned on the TV on time.
questions.e: 「Anna 不想錯過那個有趣的直播秀」為原因，「很早到家並準時打開電視」為結果，故用 so（所以）來連接兩句，故選(C)。

questions.q: My husband is cleaning our apartment now because his parents ＿＿＿ over for dinner tonight. He needs to make sure the apartment looks nice and clean to them.
questions.e: 丈夫正在打掃公寓，如此父母晚餐來作客時，公寓才會看起來漂亮乾淨，應用未來式表達父母「將會來」晚餐，故選(D)。

questions.q: Dora’s new camera just ＿＿＿ this morning. She can’t wait to go out and take some photos with it.
questions.e: 由後句說「等不及要出門用新相機拍照」，可推知新相機貨已經「到了」，故選(A)。

questions.q:
Ava: ＿＿＿ boxes of cookies does Ms. Wang have in her classroom?
Una: About forty. They should be enough for all the kids in her class.
questions.e: 疑問詞後接複數可數名詞 boxes of cookies，應用疑問詞 How many 詢問數量，故選(A)。

questions.q: The woman told the strange man to ＿＿＿ her daughter, or she would call the police.
questions.e: 後半句說「否則要報警」，可推知應該是要陌生男子「遠離」自己的女兒，故選(D)。

questions.q: Which group of people are in different “time zones”?
o: Lisa and her family. Lisa’s family lives in Tainan, but she studies in Taipei.
Louis and his brother. Louis works from 9 to 5, but his brother has to work at night.
Emma and her friends. Emma is on a trip to Canada, and she’ll buy gifts for her friends in Taiwan.
Ben and his secretary. Ben’s secretary is late today, and Ben is waiting for her in the office angrily.
questions.e: 前文提到「老師在美國；其他同學來自世界各地」，可推知 time zone 指「時區」，選項中只有(C)的 Emma 和朋友們分別在加拿大跟臺灣，也就是在不同的時區，故選(C)。

questions.q: Which is true about the dialogue (對話)?
o: Students usually don’t have a chance to speak in the online class.
Mr. Miller is going to teach an online class in the USA in the morning.
Ariel is going to the movies by herself because Danny can’t go with her.
Mr. Miller uses a real blackboard when he teaches online classes.
questions.e: (A) Danny 說只有聽不到時才會打字，表示平時是可以說話的；(C) 第一句提到會跟 Peter 一起看電影，不是自己一個人；(D) 對話只提到學生們可以看到老師的螢幕分享，就像教室的黑板一樣，沒說老師會使用真的黑板，故選(B)。

questions.q: Which might be Danny’s online English classroom?（選項為下圖四張畫面）
questions.e: 由 Danny 的描述可知，可以在右手邊看到同學的臉、老師的臉在右上角，而中間則有老師的教學螢幕，下方可以打字輸入，故選(D)。

questions.q: What does “gifts” refer to (意指) here?
questions.e: 由上下文所述，草木乾枯、土地乾裂、水塘乾涸、牲畜飢渴、糧食歉收，可推知現在正發生乾旱，人們會祈求降雨，因此正在等待的「禮物」即是「天降甘霖」，故選(C)。

questions.q: How does the narrator (敘事者) sound in the reading?
o: Lucky but sorry at the same time.
Unhappy at first but happy at last.
questions.e: 敘事者敘述了旱災時萬物凋零的景象，以及人們渴求雨水的煎熬，但卻什麼也沒等到，可推知敘事者是憂心忡忡且希望渺茫的，故選(A)。

questions.q: What does “throw us a curveball” mean here?
o: Say hi to us by throwing baseballs at our players’ bodies.
Change their future plans to give us a helping hand.
Ask us to join their practice and win the game together.
Surprise us with something difficult to deal with.
questions.e: 由第二段可知，由於歷史系棒臨時更換先發投手，數學系棒必須調整先發投手與打擊順序來因應這個問題，可推知 throw sb. a curveball 是指突然給某人出了一道意料之外的難題之意，故選(D)。

questions.q: What can we learn from the reading?
o: Players of the Department of Math don’t need to bring their own water tomorrow.
Both the teams in the game tomorrow changed their starting pitchers.
The baseball team of the Department of Math should arrive at the field at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
Wayne Hsu’s curveballs always move fast and straight to the catcher’s glove.
questions.e: (A) 要自己帶水；(C) 比賽九點開始，要在比賽開始前兩小時（七點）到達棒球場；(D) Wayne Hsu 的曲球在進入捕手手套前會向下偏移，故選(B)。

questions.q: Which is the batting order (打擊順序) of the BOM in the game tomorrow?（選項為下圖四張表）
questions.e: 由第二段可知，強棒 Ethan 打第四棒，他前後分別是 Joshua 和 Jamie，第一、二棒是 Hank 和 Nelson，六到九棒則是 Brad、Steve、Ian 和 Charles；此外，數學系棒先發投手改為狀態較佳的 Jamie，捕手則是 Brad，故選(C)。

questions.q: Which bedrooms are Karen’s, Zoe’s, and Leo’s?（見平面圖）
o: A Karen’s; B Zoe’s; C Leo’s.
A Leo’s; B Karen’s; C Zoe’s.
A Zoe’s; B Karen’s; C Leo’s.
A Zoe’s; B Leo’s; C Karen’s.
questions.e: 由 Zoe 描述，Leo 的房間有浴室，可知是 C 房，而 Karen 的房間離廚房較遠，可知是 B 房，Zoe 則住在 A 房，故選(C)。

questions.q: What does it mean when someone is “bothered”?
o: The person feels lonely and unhappy.
The person doesn’t want to live with others.
The person always has great ideas.
The person feels worried and troubled.
questions.e: 由全篇信件可知，Zoe 與人同住時遇到一些問題，想換房間又不知道如何開口，可以推知 bothered 表示「憂慮的、困擾的」，故選(D)。

questions.q: Sarah wrote back to Zoe after she read the letter. Which of the following is most likely (可能地) part of the letter?
o: ...I was so worried because it was difficult to find a place to stay in only a week. When you said I could stay in your apartment, I was so happy and couldn’t thank you enough. Thank you for sending me the floor plan too. Your apartment looks great, and I can’t wait to stay there with you...

...You really need to talk to both of them. First, Karen also uses the bathroom, so she needs to clean it. Although she’s busy, being busy can’t always be an excuse. As for Leo, he needs to clean the kitchen after he uses it. It’s just not right for you to clean every corner of the apartment...

...To be honest, I don’t think changing rooms is a good idea. It’s hard for you to bring this up to them, and it takes you time to move everything to another room. Try to talk to Karen first. Maybe she can make food without that much smoke, for example, chicken soup or salad...

...There are always problems coming up when you share an apartment with someone else. You can try to deal with them or just run away. Don’t give yourself a hard time. If you really don’t feel comfortable about paying the 500 more NT dollars, moving out may be a better idea for you...
questions.e: Zoe 在信中提到面臨的問題，是 Karen 太常打掃浴室以及煮飯油煙的問題，因此 Zoe 想要換房間，Sarah 的回信應該會針對以上問題做回覆，故選(C)。

questions.q: Which programs are most likely (可能地) Programs ①, ②, ③, and ④?（見長條圖）
o: ① Strange Food　② Scary Dragons　③ Mother-in-Law　④ City Girls
① Mother-in-Law　② Strange Food　③ City Girls　④ Scary Dragons
① Scary Dragons　② Strange Food　③ Mother-in-Law　④ City Girls
① City Girls　② Mother-in-Law　③ Strange Food　④ Scary Dragons
questions.e: 由對話內容可知，Scary Dragons 是最成功的節目，且主要觀眾是孩子，與節目④相符；City Girls 是次成功的節目，超過五千人喜歡在晚上看此節目，與①相符；Mother-in-Law 與 Strange Food 表現較不佳，且由 Mother-in-Law 是表現最糟的節目，可知②為 Mother-in-Law，③為 Strange Food，故選(D)。

questions.q: Which might be the new schedule (時刻表) of PES TV?（選項為下圖四張時刻表）
questions.e: PES TV 在本次會議中做出的重要決定包括將 Scary Dragons 移到孩子放學時間、調整 Mother-in-Law 的播出時間至 14:00-16:00 以符合家庭主婦作息、將 Strange Food 移至觀眾較少的早上時段，而 City Girls 則維持 20:00-22:00 播出，故選(C)。

questions.q: What do we learn from the meeting of PES TV?
o: PES TV is going to stop airing their best program next month because the summer vacation will be over soon.
City Girls is a successful TV program of PES TV, and it is very popular with both housewives and kids.
Ben doesn’t agree with Cate’s idea of changing the TV program during 20:00-22:00 because few people watch TV then.
Amy doesn’t think it’s a good idea to stop airing their worst program; she thinks they should air it in different hours.
questions.e: 由對話中後段可知，Amy 不同意 Cate 停播最差節目的提議，認為問題出在播出時間，因此建議調整節目播出時段，故選(D)。

questions.q: What does the word “they” refer to (意指) here?
questions.e: 根據前文，采采蠅以人和動物的血為食，且最末段描述防治昏睡病（sleeping sickness）的方法之一為避免蚊蠅叮咬，由此可推知這裡的「牠們」指的是采采蠅，故選(C)。

questions.q: What is true about people with sleeping sickness?
o: They have trouble sleeping because their brains hurt.
They can’t tell nights from days and sleep all day long.
They will build up a 24-hour sleep-wake cycle in months.
There’s no medicine for sleeping sickness, so they turn to dark magic for help.
questions.e: 由第二段敘述可知，被采采蠅叮咬後約一個月，寄生蟲會進入人類的腦部進行攻擊，造成腦部受損、無法辨別白天與黑夜，進而引發昏睡病的典型症狀之一：睡眠失調，故選(A)。

questions.q:
What happens in order after tsetse flies with parasites bite a man?
a. Parasites attack the man’s brain.
b. The man starts to have trouble sleeping.
c. The man starts to have a headache and a fever.
d. Parasites go from tsetse flies to the man’s body.
questions.e: 根據文章所述，昏睡病的起因為寄生蟲透過采采蠅叮咬進入人體，首先會引發頭痛與高燒，當寄生蟲進入人腦後，則會引起睡眠問題，故選(D)。

questions.q: Which is NOT true about Melody Music?
o: It gives people a list of new songs every day.
People can set the music to play automatically to wake them up.
There are millions of songs from around the world on it.
People can listen to music on it when they are driving.
questions.e: 介紹的最後一點提到可以設定讓音樂自動停止播放，並未提到可以用來叫人起床，故選(B)。

questions.q: Which is true about the ad (廣告)?
o: Melody Music had the fewest new songs in November this year.
The number in “＿?＿” is one hundred and eighty.
Everyone can use Melody Music for free for a month in December.
Melody Music had forty more new songs in March than in February.
questions.e: (A) 新增最少首新歌的月分是 8 和 12 月；(B) 由圖表可知，新增最少首新歌的月分都有 160 首歌，空格不應填入 180；(C) 只有上網答題的人可以免費使用，而且只有一週，不是一個月；(D) 3 月有 240 首，2 月有 200 首，為正確敘述，故選(D)。

questions.q:
Lisa wants to use Melody Music to enjoy music, and she is talking about it with Dan:
Lisa: I was planning to buy a 12-month plan, but my dad gave me only $1,000.
Dan: Well, to be honest, it’s not a good idea to buy a plan straight for a year. What if Melody Music isn’t that good? Just choose the 3-month Star Plan first.
Lisa: OK. But I really want to download some songs for free.
Dan: How about listening without the Net? Do you need that?
Lisa: No, I always stay in places with the Internet.
Which plan is Lisa going to buy most likely (可能地)?
questions.e: 根據 Lisa 所說，她想要下載歌曲，但不需要無網聽歌，所以較有可能會選擇的為 Moon Plan，又因為她只有一千元，且 Dan 建議她不要一次買太長時間，可推知 Lisa 最有可能先買三個月的 Moon Plan，故選(C)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 35 格的答案。
questions.e: Pizztopia 明年才要推出新口味炒麵披薩，因此應使用未來式，故選(A)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 36 格的答案。
questions.e: plan + to V 表「計畫做某事」，故選(B)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 37 格的答案。
questions.e: 主詞 their pizza flavors 為複數，且本句在陳述披薩口味很有趣的事實，應用現在式而非過去式，故選(C)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 38 格的答案。
questions.e: 由前段主要敘述 Pizztopia 的披薩口味很有趣，而本句空格後提到「對義大利人來說，在披薩上放滷肉飯或麵條這樣的食物並不是一件令人興奮的事。」，可知應用 however（然而）表示語氣轉折，故選(B)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 39 格的答案。
o: she died quietly in the river
she put her daughter in the river
she attacked people by the river
questions.e: 空格前提到沒有發出任何聲音，後句則提到「她去世後……」，可推知空格為「她安靜地死在河裡」，故選(A)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 40 格的答案。
o: After people moved her out of the river
When she was eating the pineapple
Although elephants shouldn’t feed on pineapples
Because the pineapple was not delicious
questions.e: 由前文可知鳳梨內有爆竹，而空格後面提到「爆竹在她的口中爆炸了」，因此空格文意應為「當她正在吃鳳梨的時候」，故選(B)。

questions.q: 選出最適合填入第 41 格的答案。
o: the suspect said sorry to the mother elephant
people started to check the pineapple farms around
reporters stopped taking pictures of the poor elephants
some people started to draw pictures of the elephants
questions.e: 後句為「他們希望這些圖片可以……」，可推知前句表示當新聞在網路上傳開後，「有些人開始畫這些大象的圖」，故選(D)。
